```{r}
source(if(file.exists("R/table_formatting.R")) "R/table_formatting.R" else "../R/table_formatting.R")
library(tibble)

baseline_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Software, ~Anwendung, ~Memory,
  "SAS",   "Fallzahl",   "65 MB",
  "SAS",   "Regression", "7 MB"
)

tbl_out <- format_baseline_table(baseline_data, 
                                   label = "test",
                                   caption = "Test Table")

output_table(tbl_out)
```
